status: Intermittent handshake failure observed; subsequent client login succeeded without server changes. Initial cause remains unresolved.
incident: Server.log 11:11:17: account 2 requested instance connection serial 17.
11:11:27: accepted loopback peer port 50486 reached the 10-second handshake deadline with initializer 0, continued auth 0 and buffered bytes 0.
The server's AbortSocket caused the pending read to finish with Windows connection_aborted; InitializeHandler logged this as an error in addition to the timeout warning.
11:11:29: serials 35, 53, 71 and 89 were requested and login aborted within the same logged second. No successful continued authentication was observed for that login.
Client.log: Character Login SEND at 11:11:17.402; login failed at 11:11:29.570 without Active Player Created.

read_only_investigation.configuration: Canonical runtime was already running, bound to 127.0.0.1; world port 8085 and instance port 8086 were listening in the same worldserver process.
transport_probes: 80 unauthenticated TCP probes, 40 per port, concurrency 8: all received the exact server initializer and an authentication challenge.
800 additional unauthenticated probes, 400 per port, concurrency 8, fragmented client initializers: all received the exact server initializer and full 55-byte challenge.
read_only_investigation.probe_limit: These probes exercise accepted TCP sockets, initializer parsing and challenge transmission. They do not authenticate, simulate a character login, reproduce the original silent client, or prove absence of a rare transport/scheduling problem.
read_only_investigation.packet_capture: PktMon status/filter inspection was denied by the driver. No packet capture or filter changes were made.
read_only_investigation.source_review: Reviewed acceptor/network-thread handoff, socket write/read queue, initializer deadline, instance retry deadlines and failure reports. No speculative timing/configuration or retry changes were deployed.

client_retest.evidence: Client.log 11:16:50.609: Character Login SEND; 11:16:51.988: Active Player Created and Loading Screen Disable.
client_retest.meaning: A real login completed against the same running executable and configuration. This confirms recovery on retry, not repair of the intermittent initial handshake failure.

runtime.changes: None to production source, executable, configuration, database, character positions, inventories or client files.
runtime.handoff: worldserver.exe and bnetserver.exe stopped gracefully as requested; world database shutdown completed at 11:17:47. Client process was not controlled.

open_questions: Why the first accepted instance socket received no client initializer: the log alone does not establish whether the server greeting was sent/received or why the client remained silent.
Why the remaining attempt serials failed immediately after the first deadline; source inspection and synthetic successful handshakes do not establish their actual client failure cause.
next_reproduction: If the failure recurs, correlate actual instance-connection greeting write completion, client initializer receipt and client CONNECT_TO_FAILED reports by local/remote port and attempt serial. Preserve the bounded retry safeguards; do not claim that increasing the timeout or suppressing its warning fixes the cause.
